stance_basis: officially adopted the Randolph Plan and filed the original HUD application for the project
summary: The Richmond Redevelopment and Housing Authority (RRHA) is the project applicant and a central institutional actor in the Randolph Urban Renewal project. It filed the original 1967 application with HUD for loans and grants, engaged in a joint 24-month planning effort with the Randolph Planning Study Board, and in January 1973 its Commissioners officially adopted the Randolph Plan. The RRHA also retains right-of-review over landscape plans within the redevelopment area, underscoring its ongoing administrative role in implementing the project.
complaint_summary: The RRHA engaged in a joint 24-month planning effort with the Randolph Planning Study Board to incorporate community goals into the proposed action plans, after which the RPSB adopted the Randolph Plan.
summary_quote: During January, 1973, the Commissioners of the Richmond Redevelopment and Housing Authority officially adopted the Randolph Plan.
